titleText.es: Tan solo asegúrate de que no lo pones a maximizar en lugar de minimizar.
titleText.en: Just make sure you don't have it maximize instead of minimize.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish archive translates the official warning about accidentally maximizing rather than minimizing the cost; both title texts depend on the optimization joke in the image.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: for; introduces the topic or field that advice applies to
cardDefinitions.noteEn: After consejo, guía, or recomendación, para can introduce the area or situation in which the advice is meant to be used.

example.es: Este consejo es para viajes largos.
example.en: This tip is for long trips.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Genéticos describes masculine plural things as related to genes, inheritance, or a process modeled on biological evolution.
Incluye tells one familiar listener to include something. The same written form can mean ‘he, she, or formal you includes’ in a statement; the advice context makes it a command here.

example.es: Incluye tu dirección en el formulario.
example.en: Include your address on the form.

cardDefinitions.answerEn: fitness; quality score (in an optimization algorithm)
cardDefinitions.noteEn: In a genetic algorithm, aptitud is the measured quality assigned to a candidate solution. It is a technical use related to how well that candidate meets the goal, not a person's ordinary talent.

example.es: El programa calcula la aptitud de cada solución.
example.en: The program calculates the fitness of each solution.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: What do you call the rule that scores candidate solutions in a genetic algorithm?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: Use función de aptitud for ‘fitness function.’
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Función names the scoring rule, de links it to the technical noun aptitud, and the complete phrase names the function used to compare candidate solutions. Depending on the setup, a program may seek a higher fitness score or a lower cost.

example.es: La función de aptitud asigna una puntuación a cada solución.
example.en: The fitness function assigns a score to each solution.

cardDefinitions.questionEn: Why does the enormous cost assigned to becoming Skynet matter to the joke?
cardDefinitions.answerEn: A genetic algorithm searches for good candidate solutions by optimizing a fitness or cost function, so a huge cost can make an unwanted outcome extremely unattractive when the program minimizes cost.
cardDefinitions.noteEn: Skynet is the hostile artificial intelligence in the Terminator stories. The code treats an AI takeover as just another outcome to penalize. The title-text warning completes the joke: if the program maximized this cost instead, the enormous number would encourage precisely that outcome.

applications.explanationEn: Algoritmos names the technical objects first, and the neutral description genéticos follows it.
Genéticos uses masculine plural -os to match algoritmos.
Incluye is the positive command for one familiar listener.
Función names the scoring rule, de links it to its technical type, and aptitud names the score used to compare candidate solutions.
